title: Reasoning Models Are Accurate but Unsound on Identification
abstract: arXiv:2610.03519v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A reasoning model asked whether a causal effect is recoverable from observational data can fail in two ways: it refuses an identifiable query or answers a nonidentifiable one. The latter is more consequential, as no observational data can validate the claimed formula. Measuring this failure requires queries that are provably non-identifiable, which prior evaluations lack, and grading that accepts correct formulas in any equivalent form, which string matching cannot provide. We build CERTID, a formal identification pipeline that addresses both limitations. CERTID uses the sound and complete causal identification algorithm ID to certify whether an effect is identifiable from a given graph and query, and verifies returned formulas against structural causal models whose interventional distributions are known exactly. translated_title: 推理模型在因果识别上准确但不可靠
translated_abstract: 当被问及某个因果效应能否从观测数据中恢复时，推理模型可能以两种方式失败：拒绝回答本可识别的查询，或回答本不可识别的查询。后者后果更为严重，因为没有任何观测数据能够验证其所声称的公式。衡量这种失败需要可证明为不可识别的查询——这是以往评估所缺乏的——同时还需要能够接受任何等价形式正确公式的评分方式——这是字符串匹配无法提供的。我们构建了CERTID，一个解决上述两个局限的形式化识别流水线。CERTID使用可靠且完备的因果识别算法ID来认证某个效应在给定图和查询下是否可识别，并通过干预分布可被精确获知的结构因果模型来验证模型返回的公式。CERTID进一步发展了理论结果，以缓解结构信息泄露、修复不可识别的查询，并建立评分标准（原文此处截断）。
tldr: 本文提出CERTID——一个基于可靠且完备的ID算法和结构因果模型精确验证的形式化因果识别评测流水线，首次提供了可证明不可识别的查询及等价公式评分，用以揭示推理模型在因果效应可识别性判断上虽准确但不可靠（会回答不可识别查询）的失败模式。
en_tdlr: CERTID is a formal identification pipeline that uses the sound and complete ID algorithm and exact verification against structural causal models to provide provably non-identifiable queries and equivalent-form grading, exposing reasoning models' unsound failures in causal effect identification.
